newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek inflation to fall again in Dec - minister.
newsitem.headline: Greek inflation to fall again in Dec - minister.

text.p: Greece's 7.7 percent CPI inflation rate will fall again in December despite a crippling three-week national road blockade by farmers, National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou told Reuters Television.
"We expect a further fall in December despite the farmers' blockade. Perhaps a minimum fall but my understanding is that there will be a small fall," he said in an interview.

He added: "Of course, there will be a very substantial fall next year. In fact in the first semester of next year we expect a very substantial fall in inflation rates which are helped, of course, by national oil prices."
The farmers' blockade to press economic demands had failed to have a significant effect on consumer price inflation because people had found ways around the problem, he said.
He noted the blockades had hit transportation hard and had stopped people from getting to tax offices around Greece to make their payments, hitting revenue targets.
